suggestions.title: Inception
suggestions.description: A thief who enters the dreams of others to steal secrets is tasked with planting an idea instead — an act of inception that could reshape reality itself.

suggestions.title: Parasite
suggestions.description: A poor family schemes their way into the lives of a wealthy household with unexpected and devastating consequences in this Palme d'Or winner.

suggestions.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
suggestions.description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a drifter teams up with a fierce warrior to escape a tyrannical warlord in this visually stunning masterpiece.
